_source.note: id and order are BannerPatterns.bootstrap. code is BannerPatternFormatFix.PATTERN_ID_MAP, the short string 1.8 to 1.20.4 stored as Pattern; flow and guster arrived after that format ended and have none. name is en_us.json's block.minecraft.banner.<id>.white with the colour taken off. since is the first release a design can be made in without experiments: the wiki's history, corroborated mechanically by whether textures/entity/banner/<id>.png exists in each release's assets (globe first at 1.14, piglin at 1.16, flow and guster at 1.20.5 but behind the update_1_21 experiment until 1.21). description is written looking at each texture's front window (u 1..21, v 1..41 of 64), as the front of the banner shows it.
_source.formats: invertedColorsBefore is where BlockEntityBannerColorFix is registered (schema 1451, the Flattening): before it Base and Color are 15 minus the dye id. namedPatternsFrom is where BannerPatternFormatFix is registered (schema 3818): before it a layer is {Pattern:<code>,Color:<int>} in a list called Patterns, from it {pattern:<id>,color:<name>} in one called patterns.

patterns.name: Field
patterns.description: Covers the whole flag. Used as the first layer, it repaints the banner's own colour for everything above it.

patterns.name: Base Dexter Canton
patterns.description: A rectangle in the bottom-left corner: the left half of the bottom third.

patterns.name: Base Sinister Canton
patterns.description: A rectangle in the bottom-right corner: the right half of the bottom third.

patterns.name: Chief Dexter Canton
patterns.description: A rectangle in the top-left corner: the left half of the top third.

patterns.name: Chief Sinister Canton
patterns.description: A rectangle in the top-right corner: the right half of the top third.

patterns.name: Base
patterns.description: A horizontal band across the bottom third of the flag.

patterns.name: Chief
patterns.description: A horizontal band across the top third of the flag.

patterns.name: Pale Dexter
patterns.description: A vertical band down the left third of the flag.

patterns.name: Pale Sinister
patterns.description: A vertical band down the right third of the flag.

patterns.name: Pale
patterns.description: A vertical band down the middle of the flag, about a third of its width.

patterns.name: Fess
patterns.description: A narrow horizontal band across the middle of the flag, about a fifth of its height.

patterns.name: Bend
patterns.description: A diagonal band from the top-left corner down to the bottom-right corner.

patterns.name: Bend Sinister
patterns.description: A diagonal band from the top-right corner down to the bottom-left corner.

patterns.name: Paly
patterns.description: Four thin vertical stripes running the full height of the flag, evenly spaced.

patterns.name: Saltire
patterns.description: A diagonal cross: two bands from corner to corner, meeting in the centre like an X.

patterns.name: Cross
patterns.description: An upright cross: a vertical band down the middle and a horizontal band across the middle.

patterns.name: Chevron
patterns.description: A triangle standing on the whole bottom edge, rising to a point at the centre of the flag.

patterns.name: Inverted Chevron
patterns.description: A triangle hanging from the whole top edge, down to a point at the centre of the flag.

patterns.name: Base Indented
patterns.description: Three small saw-teeth standing along the bottom edge.

patterns.name: Chief Indented
patterns.description: Three small saw-teeth hanging along the top edge.

patterns.name: Per Bend Sinister
patterns.description: The top-left half of the flag, above the diagonal from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner.

patterns.name: Per Bend Sinister Inverted
patterns.description: The bottom-right half of the flag, below the diagonal from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner.

patterns.name: Per Bend Inverted
patterns.description: The bottom-left half of the flag, below the diagonal from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner.

patterns.name: Per Bend
patterns.description: The top-right half of the flag, above the diagonal from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner.

patterns.name: Roundel
patterns.description: A disc in the centre of the flag.

patterns.name: Lozenge
patterns.description: A large diamond in the centre of the flag, about three fifths of its width and height.

patterns.name: Per Pale
patterns.description: The left half of the flag.

patterns.name: Per Fess
patterns.description: The top half of the flag.

patterns.name: Per Pale Inverted
patterns.description: The right half of the flag.

patterns.name: Per Fess Inverted
patterns.description: The bottom half of the flag.

patterns.name: Bordure
patterns.description: A straight frame around all four edges of the flag.

patterns.name: Bordure Indented
patterns.description: A frame around all four edges whose inner edge is scalloped into rounded notches.

patterns.name: Gradient
patterns.description: The colour is solid at the top and fades out towards the bottom, where what is underneath shows through.

patterns.name: Base Gradient
patterns.description: The colour is solid at the bottom and fades out towards the top, where what is underneath shows through.

patterns.name: Field Masoned
patterns.description: Brickwork over the whole flag: the bricks take the colour, and the thin mortar lines between them show what is underneath.

patterns.name: Globe
patterns.description: A small globe, in the middle of the flag.

patterns.name: Creeper Charge
patterns.description: A creeper's face in the middle of the flag.

patterns.name: Skull Charge
patterns.description: A skull over crossed bones, in the middle of the flag.

patterns.name: Flower Charge
patterns.description: A round flower with eight petals, in the middle of the flag.

patterns.name: Thing
patterns.description: The Mojang logo, in the middle of the flag.

patterns.name: Snout
patterns.description: A piglin's snout with its two nostrils, in the middle of the flag.

patterns.name: Flow
patterns.description: A squared-off spiral, in the middle of the flag.

patterns.name: Guster
patterns.description: A breeze, the wind mob of trial chambers, in the middle of the flag.
